pages.text: These tiered power generators will generate a small amount of FE during daylight hours while it is not raining.$(br2)Each successive tier will generate additional power.
$(li)Basic: 1x power generation$(li)Intermediate: 2x power generation$(li)Advanced: 4x power generation$(li)Industrial: 8x power generation
A compact solar generator that generates 1 FE/t in daylight. Perfect for use with $(l:processenhancement:infrastructure/lantern)Electric Lanterns$(/l)!
